preconditions.description: The number of members n must be between 3 and 150,000.
The number of friendships m must be non-negative and cannot exceed the maximum possible number of unique pairs of members.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in friendships)
preconditions.description: Each friendship pair must consist of distinct members within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if all((a, b) in friendships for a, b in combinations(friendships, 2)) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if the network satisfies the transitive property for all triplets of members, otherwise 'NO'.
